text:
Priya (PM): starting a compact thread to finalize the stability-gating and pre-approval + audit requirements for the upcoming rollout (feature: multi-variant routing v1). goal: low-risk tenant opt-in alpha -> staggered regional ramps with explicit pre-approval checks and audit logs.
Noah (Eng): high-level: implement a feature flag with three cohorts: baseline, variantA, and persistent 1% holdback. rollout flow: EU shadow 24h (10% shadow) -> NA opt-in visible 3% -> 20% -> gate. auto-decay rule to halve traffic on metric breaches.
Sam (SRE): canary infra: reserve warm pool in eu-west + us-east. alarms to wire: sustained p99 > 340ms OR error_rate(5xx)>0.5% for 8m -> trigger auto-decay; if unresolved after 6m -> auto-rollback. add per-tenant kill switch and pre-approval enforcement.
Ivy (Data): telemetry list: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, rolling quality delta on seeded evals, and per-cohort counts. quick smoke uses a 2k human spot-check; full A/B needs ~10k requests/arm for ~1.5% detectable delta.
Priya (PM): launch gates we agree on: smoke at 3% (no infra alarms, quick smoke pass, no obvious quality regressions), staged ramp to 20% with manual sign-off, full roll only after quality delta <=1.2% and no degraded infra alarms for 48h. must include tenant pre-approval flag for enterprise customers.
Noah (Eng): flag JSON draft for ops (paste to ops-config):
```json
{"flag":"multi_variant_route_v1","mode":"opt_in","variants":[{"name":"baseline","ratio":0.97},{"name":"variantA","ratio":0.03}],"shadow":{"EU":0.10},"holdback":0.01,"auto_decay":{"metric":"p99","pct_threshold":18,"decay_factor":0.5},"kill_switch":"global_off","tenant_preapproval_field":"pre_approved"}
```
Sam (SRE): fallback choreography: 1) auto-decay on threshold breach; 2) try quantized-fallback for 2m; 3) if still unhealthy, route traffic to baseline and open incident marker. add rate-limiter per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbor-induced alarms.
Ivy (Data): dashboards: I'll add panels for lift, p-values, per-tenant counts, rolling p99, and a diff view that compares holdback vs variant every 30m. will also wire an alert if sample counts < expected threshold.
Priya (PM): enterprise ask: Customer Alpha requires EU-only exposure + signed pre-approval and a tamper-proof audit trail for any per-tenant override. we need audit-bot entries with approver id and timestamp.
audit-bot: noted. will emit entries: "audit:flag-change:{tenant}:{approver}:{ts}" to the audit log stream and store signed metadata in the audit bucket.
Sam (SRE): operational items: implement pre-approval enforcement (no visible assignment unless tenant metadata.pre_approved==true), per-tenant blackout windows, and ensure audit events are generated for any manual override. scheduling a 20m pre-canary runbook review.
Noah (Eng): infra todos:
- implement flag schema and pre-approval checker
- shadow routing + holdback cohort
- adaptive-decay controller + fallback hooks
Ivy (Data): data todos: eval harness, dashboards, sample seeding.
Priya (PM): comms/runbook: I'll draft tenant messaging, rollback FAQ, and a short decision matrix for pre-approvals. target soft launch window: 2026-07-12.
Priya (PM): blockers? :eyes:
Noah (Eng): need adaptive-decay CI green by 2026-07-08.
Sam (SRE): will block if audit pipeline not emitting signed events or canary pool not reserved.
Ivy (Data): dashboards ETA: 2026-07-07 EOD.
Priya (PM): great. I'll post the finalized runbook in #launchroom after the pre-canary review and PR merges. tagging @Noah @Sam @Ivy for follow-up. thanks!
